Tailored Luxury Living Solution 

Our luxurious expandable container house has a scientific and reasonable internal planning. A comfortable bedroom provides a cozy resting space, a clean bathroom creates a refreshing environment, and a practical kitchen inspires cooking enthusiasm. It is an ideal and comfortable villa. The unique folding design is a highlight. The installation process is extremely simple and does not require complicated assembly steps. It is carefully built with high-quality materials and has excellent waterproof and sound insulation performance. The internal layout can be flexibly customized according to personal preferences. The exterior design is exquisite and fashionable, and there are a variety of colors to choose from, which can fully meet your personalized needs.

Convenient mobile transportation

High location flexibility: The  collapsible container house can be easily moved to a variety of different locations. Whether it is a scenic seaside, a quiet mountain, a vast grassland, or a corner of the city, as long as the site conditions permit, it can be placed. This allows people to choose the living or use environment according to their preferences. For example, if you want to enjoy the sound of waves and sea breeze at the seaside, you can transport it to the seaside and easily realize the desire of "traveling with the house".


Quick commissioning: For some temporary activities or projects, its mobility advantage is more obvious. For example, as a temporary tourist service station during the peak tourist season, it can be quickly transported to the site and put into use. When the project is over or the season is over, it can be easily moved to other places, saving a lot of time and resources.

Customized and personalized

Diverse exterior designs: From the exterior, the expandable container house can be customized according to personal preferences. Whether you like the sense of lines in modern minimalist style or prefer the color matching of retro style, you can achieve it through customization. You can choose different facade materials, colors and decorative elements to make the appearance of the house coordinated with the surrounding environment, or show a unique personality.


Freedom of interior decoration: In terms of interior decoration, the degree of freedom is also very high. You can design the layout according to your living habits and functional needs. For the kitchen, you can choose an open or closed design, and choose the right kitchenware and cabinet style; for the bedroom, you can customize the size and position of the bed and choose your favorite decoration style. This kind of personalized customization can make each prefabricated container homes a unique space.

Obvious advantages in environmental protection and energy saving

Environmentally friendly materials: Environmentally friendly materials are usually used to build prefabricated container home. Many materials are recyclable. For example, some wall materials may use new environmentally friendly composite materials, which can be recycled and reused when the house is demolished or renovated, reducing the generation of construction waste and conforming to the concept of sustainable development.


Efficient energy utilization: In terms of energy utilization,  houses also have many energy-saving measures. It can be equipped with a solar power generation system to use solar energy to power some of the house's equipment, such as lighting systems, small appliances, etc. At the same time, its good thermal insulation performance can reduce the loss of indoor heat and the introduction of external heat, which helps save energy and reduce carbon emissions.

Customized design service

We are well aware that each customer's needs and imagination for space are unique. Therefore, the company's professional design team will communicate with customers in depth at the beginning of the service to understand in detail the customer's purpose of use, aesthetic preferences, functional requirements, budget constraints and other factors. From the overall appearance to the internal layout planning, from color matching to decorative details, every link is carefully crafted to ensure that the final expandable container house not only meets the customer's expectations, but also shows a unique charm and personality.

Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is suitable for use in both Australia and New Zealand.

Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed to provide a luxury accommodation experience.

The luxury folding container home utilizes an expandable design which allows it to be compact during transportation and expand into a larger living space at its destination.
5

The Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing can be used for various applications including temporary housing, vacation homes, and additional living spaces.
6

Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed for easy transportation and can be easily relocated to different locations as needed.
